name: chat-thread
title: Chat thread
description: A messaging conversation from a JSON list of {from, text} messages: bubbles appear one by one, yours on the right in the accent colour and theirs on the left, each of theirs after a typing indicator, and the thread scrolls up as it grows; the last message holds. The timing follows the text, about 10 s for the five default messages: lengthen the host's data-duration for more. Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Ink to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Messages (JSON)
variables.default: [{"from":"me","text":"Did the deploy go out?"},{"from":"them","text":"Yes, about ten minutes ago."},{"from":"me","text":"Any errors?"},{"from":"them","text":"None so far. Tests passed and the dashboards look clean."},{"from":"me","text":"Perfect, thanks!"}]
